overview_description.description:
Dabble brings together the best of traditional wagering and modern social media.

A lightning-fast platform, built from scratch and ready to scale sets the Dabble app apart from other technology companies. Dabble will provide a platform for sports content consumers to interact, engage and share social sports experiences.

product.name: Dabble App
product.description: A mobile betting application featuring social betting functions such as copying bets, fast withdrawals, and community interaction.

product.name: Copy Bet
product.description: A feature allowing users to replicate bets placed by others directly onto their bet slip.

product.name: Fast Withdrawals
product.description: A service providing rapid processing of withdrawal requests, averaging under 9 seconds.

product.name: Banter Channels and Group Chats
product.description: Community chat features that allow users to communicate, share bets, and engage socially within the app.

product.name: SGMs and SGM Tracker
product.description: Specialty game markets (SGMs) and a tracking tool for monitoring player props during matches.

product.name: Live Streams
product.description: Weekly live video streams featuring sports stars and personalities for community engagement.
